objective: Build a local-only transfer checklist generator that consumes wave74 replay receipt plus wave73 certificate, wave72 source receipt, and wave70-71 agent-facing artifacts, then emits a fresh-agent handoff checklist proving the six acceptance lanes can be followed from packaged evidence without public publish/push/deploy/outreach/payment/secret access.
acceptance: transfer checklist consumes wave74, wave73, wave72, wave71, and wave70 evidence and fails if any required input is missing, blocked, contaminated by public/external actions, or lane count differs from 6
receipt includes certificate_id, source_receipt_id, lane_count 6, command_count, replayed_assertion_count, transfer_step_count, package inclusion checks, and public_action_gate closed
pytest covers valid checklist, missing wave74, blocked wave74, lane mismatch, missing prior artifact, and public/external contamination
npm pack dry-run includes script, test, JSON evidence, and Markdown evidence
public_publish_push_gate: Jake explicit approval required; no public action assigned
